claims.claim: The UK site's shoe size charts (women's, men's, all gender) carry a first column headed Foot Length (CM), beside US, UK, and EU; the US site's same charts have no such column.
claims.page_kind: size guide (men's and all-gender panels loaded by the page's ajax URL)
claims.notes: Cells in charts.csv (4 charts). The values step 0.42 to 0.43 cm per half size and 25.4 sits at women's 10 / men's 8.5; read as printed, no rule inferred.

claims.claim: The German and Irish sites print the same men's chart with a foot-length column (Fußlänge (CM)), every cell equal to the UK site's.
claims.notes: 80 cells compared by script: GB = IE = DE.

claims.claim: Above the foot-length chart, the UK size guide points to the EMEA help centre's measuring article.
claims.exact_words: Need help? Read our foot measurement guide to find your perfect fit. View guide.

claims.claim: Measure barefoot, heel against a wall, trace, then measure heel to longest toe in centimetres; that number is the foot length, used to find the size.
claims.exact_words: Stand on the paper with your heel touching the wall and your toes pointing forward. ... Use the ruler to measure from the back of your heel to the tip of your longest toe in centimeters. Write down this number—this is your foot length! You can use these measurements to find the perfect shoe size!
claims.notes: No allowance is stated in this article; the size guide's half-size-up sentence is the allowance (br-halfup-gb).

claims.claim: A thumb's width between longest toe and shoe tip; consider a half size up from the measured size.
claims.exact_words: We recommend a thumb's width of space between your longest toe and the tip of your shoe. Consider buying a shoe that is a half size up from your measured size.
claims.notes: Same sentence on the women's, men's, and all-gender panels.

claims.claim: Same advice on the UK site, beside the foot-length chart (German: a half number larger than the measured size).
claims.exact_words: We recommend a thumb width of space between your longest toe and the tip of your shoe. Consider buying a shoe that is a half size up from your measured size.
claims.notes: DE: 'Du kannst auch einen Schuh kaufen, der eine halbe Nummer größer als deine gemessene Größe ist.'

claims.claim: About 1/2 to 1 inch of space from the longest toe to the shoe's end.
claims.exact_words: we recommend sizing so that you have approximately 1/2" to 1" – about a thumbnail's width – of space from your longest toe to the end of the shoe

claims.claim: Same 1/2 to 1 inch in the holes article; size up a half size if wearing through the toe.
claims.exact_words: Size: We recommend about 1/2" to 1" (about a thumbnail's width) of space from your longest toe to the end of the shoe. If you are experiencing holes at the end of the toe box of your shoes, consider sizing up a half-size to ensure you have enough room.

claims.claim: AU help centre: approx. 1/2 inch (a thumb's width) between big toe and shoe end.
claims.exact_words: You will always want approx. 1/2 in. of space (a thumbs width) between the end of your big toe and the end of the shoe. Shoes will give in width, but not in length.
claims.notes: Agrees on 1/2 in; the US says 1/2 to 1 in.

claims.kind: fit direction / relation to other shoes
claims.claim: Brooks shoes fit slightly shorter than other brands; order a half to one size larger than casual or dress shoes.
claims.exact_words: Compared to other brands, we most often find our shoes fit slightly shorter. We recommend ordering Brooks running shoes a half size to one size larger than what you wear in casual or dress shoes.
claims.notes: US help centre article 360028795791 carries the same second sentence (search JSON).

claims.kind: fit direction / relation to other shoes
claims.claim: Canada help centre: 1/2 size to one size larger than casual or dress shoes; Swiss unisex chart page: 1/2 to one size larger than a dress shoe.
claims.exact_words: We recommend ordering Brooks running shoes 1/2 size to one size larger than what you wear in casual or dress shoes.
claims.page_kind: help centre article; size chart page
claims.notes: en_ch: 'We recommend ordering Brooks running shoes 1/2 to one size larger than your dress shoe.' (downloads/brooks-ch-unisex.html)

claims.claim: Men's to women's length: add 1.5 sizes; women's to men's: subtract 1.5.
claims.exact_words: Length conversion is adding 1.5 sizes when going from men’s to women’s or subtracting 1.5 sizes when going from women’s to men’s. For example, if you wear a women’s 10.0 wide (D), you would wear a men’s 8.5 wide (2E).
claims.notes: The UK all-gender chart's rows agree (men's 5 = women's 6.5).

claims.exact_words: All gender ("unisex") sizes match men's sizes per industry standards.

claims.claim: No children's sizes; children's shoes run on the men's scale for length; men's 7 = big kid's 7; women's 5 = big kid's 3.5; child to women's: add 1.5 to the big kid's size.
claims.exact_words: Children’s shoes run off of the men’s sizing scale for length. Most of our men’s shoes start at a size 7 (equivalent to a big kid’s size 7) ... Our women’s shoes start at a size 5, which is equivalent to a big kid’s size 3.5 in length. To find your child’s size in women’s, add 1.5 to the big kid’s size.
claims.notes: The article also has an approximate chart (not transcribed: not a lacking scale).

claims.claim: Brooks publishes no exact measurements of its shoes; same footbed across widths.
claims.exact_words: We do not offer exact measurements for the dimensions of our footwear, as it is difficult to communicate that information in a way that is helpful. ... Narrow, medium, and wide shoes within the same model are built on the same size footbed.
claims.notes: Bears on tier choice: the foot-length column is the UK sites' only length figure.

claims.claim: A 2D measure (ruler, Brannock) only approximates true size; lasts differ; Brooks shoes are in US sizes; no Australian sizing.
claims.exact_words: Because the foot is three-dimensional, any two-dimensional measuring tool, such as a ruler or Brannock device® can only approximate your true shoe size. ... Note that the Brooks running shoes are all in US sizes.
claims.notes: Also: 'Brooks works in USA sizing, which is larger than UK sizing.'

claims.claim: The AU help centre's conversion chart has Japan Men (cm) and Japan Women (cm) columns, named as Japan sizes, not as the foot's length.
claims.exact_words: US Men | US Women | UK Men | UK Women | Europe Unisex | Japan Men (cm) | Japan Women (cm)
claims.notes: Not transcribed (a label scale, read in the earlier pass if kept).
